tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: PRIMARY · Tomato. The one warm accent. Fills the primary button and marks the current language. Text on it is `on-primary` (5.3:1 day, 7.9:1 night). As text it reads on `background` and `surface` only (4.9:1+) — never on `accent`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover. `on-primary` on it: 6.7:1 day, 9.4:1 night.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed. `on-primary` on it: 8.4:1 day, 6.4:1 night.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and emoji on any `primary` fill. White by day, near-black at night (the night tomato is light).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: SECONDARY · Ink. Outline and label of the secondary button, the focus ring, the language underline on hover. Same value as `text-primary`: the notebook is ink + one accent.

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Wash behind the secondary button, nav links and FAQ rows on hover. `text-primary` on it 14.6:1 / 12.9:1.

tokens.name: secondary-pressed
tokens.usage: Wash for pressed secondary controls and the open FAQ row. `text-primary` 12.9:1 / 11.2:1; `text-secondary` 5.7:1 / 6.4:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: ACCENT · Marker. A highlighter stroke behind a few words (the hero's second line) and the selected-step tint. Only `text-primary` sits on it (14.0:1 / 11.5:1). Use at most once per screen.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: BACKGROUND · Paper. The page.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: SURFACE · Card. Note cards, FAQ, location cards, form fields, the mobile menu sheet.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Photo and map placeholders; the footer ground. `text-secondary` on it 6.2:1 / 7.5:1.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: TEXT PRIMARY · Ink. Headlines and body on `background`, `surface`, `surface-muted`, `accent` and both washes — 11:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: TEXT SECONDARY · Pencil. Captions, hours, placeholders, footer text, on `background`, `surface`, `surface-muted` and washes — 5.7:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: BORDER · Hairline. 1px dividers and card outlines. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control edge: form fields, the theme toggle, contact chips. 3.6:1 on `background`, 3.8:1 on `surface` by day; 4.4:1 / 4.0:1 at night.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: SUCCESS · Leaf. "Sent" confirmations, always with ✅ and words. 5.9:1+ on `background`/`surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: ERROR · Red pen. Field errors, always with a ❗ and a sentence, never color alone. Darker than `primary` by day (6.6:1 vs 4.9:1) so the two don't read as the same red.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: emoji to label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Gap between stacked small text; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and inputs (horizontal); gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; button horizontal padding; grid gutter desktop.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its content on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (top and bottom).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Page max width (content box). Centered, `space-3` side padding desktop.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of any paragraph or FAQ column — the notebook stays narrow.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Side margin on phones.

tokens.name: grid-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop columns (≥1024px): 12 × 1fr, 24px gutter inside `page-max`.

tokens.name: grid-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet columns (768–1023px): 8 × 1fr, 24px gutter.

tokens.name: grid-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile columns (<768px): 4 × 1fr, 16px gutter, `gutter-mobile` margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: SMALL: chips, contact-row icons, language underline caps, inputs' inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: MEDIUM (default): buttons, inputs, FAQ rows, note cards on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: LARGE: note cards on desktop, photo frame, booking band, mobile menu sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The light/night toggle and the mobile sticky bar only.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Width of every divider and card outline (`border` color).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Width of control edges: secondary button, inputs, toggle (`border-strong` / `secondary`).

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 3px `secondary` outline, 3px offset. ≥ 11:1 on every surface.

shadow.note: Almost none. Paper sits flat; edges come from 1px borders.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default for every card, button and field.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: ONLY the mobile menu sheet and the mobile sticky booking bar — things that float over the page.
